Biography

Sarah MacKenzie leads the national geospatial data infrastructure program at Natural Resources Canada. She drives the federal geospatial strategy and coordinates data sharing initiatives between provinces and territories. Former chair of the Geographic Information Management Committee (GIMC) of the federal government.
